When you open the app for the first time, you will need to enter the authentication credentials stated in the email you received from the PBX Admin into the fields described below:

![](/img/ringotel/original/943ffd633a598f2236f3/6af5418d4a60653e8ba7b1ed616d838ab765b5f8f0e8ecb4b841adb262130eca.png)

If you're using a proxy server to access your PBX, you would need to press the![App icon](/img/ringotel/original/d9a0832b28ad7afeb230/0559108243ae553dd2624cfab5b7800d5c80a7957a76680d88be8097e1910e53.png)icon and enter the IP address of your Proxy server:

![](/img/ringotel/original/b5c7a1124b7a961070bd/19309f4de40843ad72fd129b4b005c52c6390ba38a5bf6e06bf78a55452872b0.png)
